Connection.description: 🖇️ A bidirectional connection between two pieces of a design.

description.description: 💬 The optional human-readable description of the connection.
description.title: Description

gap.description: ↕️ The optional longitudinal gap (applied after rotation and tilt in connector direction) between the connected and the connecting piece.
gap.title: Gap

shift.description: ↔️ The optional lateral shift (applied after the rotation, the turn and the tilt in the plane) between the connected and the connecting piece..
shift.title: Shift

rise.description: 🪜 The optional vertical rise in connector direction between the connected and the connecting piece. Set this only when necessary as it is not a symmetric property which means that when the parent piece and child piece are flipped it yields a different result.
rise.title: Rise

rotation.description: 🔄 The optional horizontal rotation in connector direction between the connected and the connecting piece in degrees.
rotation.title: Rotation

turn.description: 🛞 The optional turn perpendicular to the connector direction (applied after rotation and the turn) between the connected and the connecting piece in degrees.  Set this only when necessary as it is not a symmetric property which means that when the parent piece and child piece are flipped it yields a different result.
turn.title: Turn

tilt.description: ↗️ The optional horizontal tilt perpendicular to the connector direction (applied after rotation and the turn) between the connected and the connecting piece in degrees.
tilt.title: Tilt

x.description: ➡️ The optional offset in x direction between the icons of the child and the parent piece in the diagram. One unit is equal the width of a piece icon.
x.title: X

y.description: ⬆️ The optional offset in y direction between the icons of the child and the parent piece in the diagram. One unit is equal the width of a piece icon.
y.title: Y

connected.description: 🧲 The connected side of the connection.

connecting.description: 🧲 The connecting side of the connection.

Connection.title: Connection

Design.description: 🏙️ A design is a collection of pieces that are connected.

description.description: 💬 The optional human-readable description of the design.
description.title: Description

icon.description: 🪙 The optional icon [ emoji | logogram | url ] of the design. The url must point to a quadratic image [ png | jpg | svg ] which will be cropped by a circle. The image must be at least 256x256 pixels and smaller than 1 MB. The image must be at least 256x256 pixels and smaller than 1 MB.
icon.title: Icon

image.description: 🖼️ The optional url to the image of the design. The url must point to a quadratic image [ png | jpg | svg ] which will be cropped by a circle. The image must be at least 720x720 pixels and smaller than 5 MB.
image.title: Image

variant.description: 🔀 The optional variant of the design. No variant means the default variant.
variant.title: Variant

view.description: 🥽 The optional view of the design. No view means the default view.
view.title: View

created.description: 🕒 The creation date of the design.
created.title: Created

updated.description: 🕒 The last update date of the design.
updated.title: Updated

Design.title: Design

Coord.description: 📺 A 2d-point (uv) of integers in screen coordinate system.

u.description: 🏁 The u-coordinate of the icon of the piece in the diagram. One unit is equal the width of a piece icon.
u.title: U

v.description: 🏁 The v-coordinate of the icon of the piece in the diagram. One unit is equal the width of a piece icon.
v.title: V

Coord.title: Coord

PieceId.description: 🪪 The props to identify the piece within the parent design.
PieceId.title: PieceId

Piece.description: ⭕ A piece is a 3d-instance of a type in a design.

description.description: 💬 The optional human-readable description of the piece.
description.title: Description

plane.description: ◳ The optional plane of the piece. When pieces are connected only one piece can have a plane.

center.description: 📺 The optional center of the piece in the diagram. When pieces are connected only one piece can have a center.

Piece.title: Piece

Plane.description: ◳ A plane is an origin (point) and an orientation (x-axis and y-axis).
Plane.title: Plane

ConnectorId.description: 🪪 The props to identify the connector within the parent type.
ConnectorId.title: ConnectorId

Connector.description: 🔌 A connector is a connection point (with a direction) of a type.

description.description: 💬 The optional human-readable description of the connector.
description.title: Description

port.description: 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 The optional port of the connector. This allows to define explicit compatibility with other connectors.
port.title: Interface

compatibleInterfaces.description: ✅ The optional other compatible ports of the connector. An empty list means this connector is compatible with all other connectors.
compatibleInterfaces.title: Compatibleports

point.description: ✖️ The connection point of the connector that is attracted to another connection point.

direction.description: ➡️ The direction of the connector. When another piece connects the direction of the other connector is flipped and then the pieces are aligned.

t.description: 💍 The parameter t [0,1[ where the connector will be shown on the ring of a piece in the diagram. It starts at 12 o`clock and turns clockwise.
t.title: T

Connector.title: Connector

Attribute.description: 🏷️ A attribute is a key value pair with an an optional definition.

value.description: 🏷️ The optional value [ text | url ] of the attribute. No value is equivalent to true.
value.title: Value

unit.description: 🏷️ The optional unit of the value of the attribute.
unit.title: Unit

definition.description: 🏷️ The optional definition [ text | uri ] of the attribute.
definition.title: Definition

Attribute.title: Attribute

Model.description: 💾 A model is a link to a resource that describes a type for a certain level of detail and tags.

url.description: 🔗 The Unique Resource Locator (URL) to the resource of the model.
url.title: Url

description.description: 💬 The optional human-readable description of the model.
description.title: Description

mime.description: ✉️ The Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) type of the content of the resource of the model.
mime.title: Mime

tags.description: 🏷️ The optional tags to group models. No tags means default.
tags.title: Tags

Model.title: Model

Side.description: 🧱 A side of a piece in a connection.
Side.title: Side

TypeId.description: 🪪 The props to identify the type.

variant.description: 🔀 The optional variant of the type. No variant means the default variant.
variant.title: Variant

TypeId.title: TypeId

Type.description: 🧩 A type is a reusable element that can be connected with other types over connectors.

description.description: 💬 The optional human-readable description of the type.
description.title: Description

icon.description: 🪙 The optional icon [ emoji | logogram | url ] of the type. The url must point to a quadratic image [ png | jpg | svg ] which will be cropped by a circle. The image must be at least 256x256 pixels and smaller than 1 MB.
icon.title: Icon

image.description: 🖼️ The optional url to the image of the type. The url must point to a quadratic image [ png | jpg | svg ] which will be cropped by a circle. The image must be at least 720x720 pixels and smaller than 5 MB.
image.title: Image

variant.description: 🔀 The optional variant of the type. No variant means the default variant.
variant.title: Variant

unit.description: Ⓜ️ The length unit of the point and the direction of the connectors of the type.
unit.title: Unit

created.description: 🕒 The creation date of the type.
created.title: Created

updated.description: 🕒 The last update date of the type.
updated.title: Updated

Type.title: Type

description: 🗃️ A kit is a collection of types and designs.

description.description: 💬 The optional human-readable description of the kit.
description.title: Description

icon.description: 🪙 The optional icon [ emoji | logogram | url ] of the kit. The url must point to a quadratic image [ png | jpg | svg ] which will be cropped by a circle. The image must be at least 256x256 pixels and smaller than 1 MB. kit.
icon.title: Icon

image.description: 🖼️ The optional url to the image of the kit. The url must point to a quadratic image [ png | jpg | svg ] which will be cropped by a circle. The image must be at least 720x720 pixels and smaller than 5 MB.
image.title: Image

preview.description: 🔮 The optional url of the preview image of the kit. The url must point to a landscape image [ png | jpg | svg ] which will be cropped by a 2x1 rectangle. The image must be at least 1920x960 pixels and smaller than 15 MB.
preview.title: Preview

version.description: 🔀 The optional version of the kit. No version means the latest version.
version.title: Version

remote.description: ☁️ The optional Unique Resource Locator (URL) where to fetch the kit remotely.
remote.title: Remote

homepage.description: 🏠 The optional url of the homepage of the kit.
homepage.title: Homepage

license.description: ⚖️ The optional license [ spdx id | url ] of the kit.
license.title: License

created.description: 🕒 The creation date of the kit.
created.title: Created

updated.description: 🕒 The last update date of the kit.
updated.title: Updated
